questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given sets.

(3, 9, 27)

(4, 16, 64)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number × 2nd number = 3rd number.

Now,

(3, 9, 27)

→ 3 × 9 = 27

(4, 16, 64)

→ 4 × 16 = 64

Similarly, for** (7, 49, 343) **

**→ 7 × 49 = 343 **

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if

they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the

statements.

Statements:

All peas are vegetables.

All carrots are vegetables.

All vegetables are greens.

Conclusions:

I. All peas are greens.

II. All greens are carrots.

III. Some greens are peas.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
**Given Statements:**

All peas are vegetables.

All carrots are vegetables.

All vegetables are greens.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768d158f751bb499b146f445deb2563dcd606919f2df77bb8c441d8a985dc4fd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6068f128839791ae3c4906041e0cef3bcf9954dcbcadd61c0f7751edfd990bf5.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All peas are greens. - True (because All peas are vegetables and All vegetables are greens. So, All peas are greens too)

II. All greens are carrots. - **False **(because All carrots are vegetables and All vegetables are greens. So, All greens are carrots it is not definite)

III. Some greens are peas. - **True **(because All peas are vegetables and All vegetables are greens. So, Some greens are peas too)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and III follow".**

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if

they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All crows are parrots.

All eagles are parrots.

All parrots are birds.

**Conclusions:**

I. No crow is a bird.

II. Some birds are eagles.

III. All birds are crows.

options.text: Either conclusion II or III follows
Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All crows are parrots.

All eagles are parrots.

All parrots are birds.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0490879e80388adb54cd8935fbe2f3ddd84288026456f3cf8699c8a2645db6a6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea8fe6f672d9215946b82c68c6bfdea7fbcc76f07b7c1c636cd687f9c90b0320.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No crow is a bird. - **False **(because All crows are parrots and All parrots are birds. So, it can not be possible)

II. Some birds are eagles** - **This is **True** because all eagles are parrots, and all parrots are birds.

III. All birds are crows - This is **False** because there are birds that are parrots but not crows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

X _ _ Y _ X X _ _ X _ _

options.text: X X X Y X X Y
X X Y Y A A X
Y X X Y Y X X
Y Y X Y A X X

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: X _ _ Y _ X X _ _ X _ _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

**Option 1)** X X X Y X X Y → X __**X**__ __**X**__ Y / __**X**__ X X __**Y**__** / **__**X**__ X __**X**__** **__**Y**__

Here, "X X X Y" pattern is followed.

Option 2) X X Y Y A A X → X __X__ __X__ Y / __Y__ X X __Y__ __A__ X __A__ __X__

Option 3) Y X X Y Y X X → X __Y__ __X__ Y / __X__ X X __Y__ __Y__ X __X__ __X__

Option 4) Y Y X Y A X X → X __Y__ __Y__ Y / __X__ X X __Y__ __A__ X __X__ __X__

Hence, the correct answer is "**X X X Y X X Y**".

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of numbers.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

4 : 32

7 : 98
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number)² × 2 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 4 : 32

⇒ (4² × 2) = 16 × 2 = 32.

For, 7 : 98

⇒ (7² × 2) = 49 × 2 = 98.

Similarly, for **3 : 18**

**⇒ (3² × 2) = 9 × 2 = 18.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
